verdict.rationale: The only integration in the evidence is an official Milvus MCP server, documented in the docs' integrations section and hosted in a first-party zilliztech repo. It lets AI applications and agents run vector searches and manage collections, which is an indirect route into agent tooling. Nothing in the pack mentions dedicated LangChain, LlamaIndex or other RAG-framework connectors, or how well they are maintained. Missing for 10: documented LangChain/LlamaIndex integrations, evidence of other RAG/agent framework connectors, evidence of active maintenance, independent or hands-on corroboration of framework usage.
